description: This Java class implements a command strategy for adjusting a loan transaction by external ID in the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests to adjust transactions through the LoanTransactionsApiResource, parsing URL components to identify the specific loan and transaction external IDs, and handles responses accordingly.

classes.name: AdjustLoanTransactionByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component that implements the CommandStrategy interface to handle adjustment of loan transactions by external ID within batch processing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch request to adjust a loan transaction by extracting URL parameters, invoking the LoanTransactionsApiResource, and producing a BatchResponse.
